Package dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockPotionTypes

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla.BedrockPotionTypes
public final class BedrockPotionTypes extends Object
The potion types of Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release, as BDS names them on the potions and the tipped arrow: BedrockItems.POTION.withEffect(BedrockPotionTypes.HEALING). Each says which items have it, at which aux.

A potion type Bedrock removes keeps its constant, deprecated. @SincePreview marks potion types only the bundled Bedrock preview has.

Since:
1.0.0
